'''Elijah Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 California State Championship]] on 5 May 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2243">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-ca-state-championship-5-5-01d2243/ ca-state-championship-5-5-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-ca-state-championship-5-5-01d2243/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
